title: Metal-Free Synthesis of α-H Chlorine Alkylaromatic Hydrocarbons Driven by Visible Light
content: Chlorination is a widely used strategy at industrial level. Chlorinated products represent indispensable building blocks in synthetic chemistry. For this reason, finding new and alternative methodologies of these compounds continues to be a challenge. Here we report the synthesis of benzyl chlorides and α-chloro alkyl arenes mediated by visible light. This methodology is a valid alternative to the syntheses previously reported in the literature. It is a metal-free process, without the use of additives and radical initiators.
